title: Symmetric Mass Generation in a Bilayer Honeycomb Lattice with $\mathrm{SU}(2)\times\mathrm{SU}(2)\times\mathrm{SU}(2)/\mathbb{Z}_2$ Symmetry
summary: A central question beyond the Landau paradigm is the non-perturbative critical theory of the symmetric mass generation (SMG) transition, where strong interactions gap Dirac fermions in (2+1) dimensions without triggering spontaneous symmetry breaking or topological order. While previous studies have already provided evidence for direct SMG transitions in (2+1) dimensions, the fermion scaling dimension -- the key observable for distinguishing candidate critical theories -- has not been determined in a controlled unbiased way.
